program_alignment.central_question: Can factor-content-aware bounded coupling reduce the D4 scalable-decoder gap that survives scope-only packing and monotone bound selection?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: matched falsification of the smallest richer partition construction
program_alignment.downstream_gate: choose whether richer region/GBP or tensor methods earn implementation cost

research_basis.local_search: Wiki roadmap, Lab 004 R6I-R6K, and current scope-first-fit implementation inspected on 2026-08-29
research_basis.primary_source: Rollon and Dechter, New Mini-Bucket Partitioning Heuristics for Bounding the Probability of Evidence, AAAI 2010, doi:10.1609/aaai.v24i1.7761
research_basis.source_change: Compare factor-content-aware greedy partition traversal with the scope-only baseline at fixed i; do not infer marginal quality from evidence-bound quality.
research_basis.project_adaptation: Because D4 factors contain exact zeros, use normalized local absolute sum-product tightening rather than logarithmic relative error; label this a zero-safe project adaptation.

model.candidate: start each bucket with singleton factors and greedily merge the legal pair maximizing the normalized decrease between separately eliminated and jointly eliminated nonnegative factor products
model.fixed_controls: same observations, priors, exact factorizations, elimination orders, i bounds, exact posterior targets, and 0.01 useful-accuracy gate
model.invariant: every total and clamped result remains a valid mini-bucket evidence upper bound; i at or above exact cluster reproduces exact evidence and marginals

matrix.conditions: 4 observations x 2 p x 2 representations x 2 orders x i={10,14,18,20}
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; no correction, LER, threshold, scaling, or fault-tolerance samples

question.H1: content-aware traversal selects consequentially different partitions or bounds on the exact cohort
question.H2: at i<=14 it improves more matched marginal rows than it worsens and increases useful-accuracy coverage
question.H3: at least one representation/order branch becomes uniformly useful over all eight conditions at i<=14
question.falsification: any invalid upper bound, exact-ceiling mismatch, nondeterministic rerun, or scope-cap violation rejects the implementation

analysis.comparison: all prospective matched rows retained; report improvements, ties, regressions, aggregate useful coverage, and exact controls
analysis.stop_rule: if H1 holds but H2/H3 fail, stop optimizing mini-bucket packing and register a region/join-graph versus tensor prerequisite; if H3 passes, validate the selected branch on paper-L2 before decoder sampling
analysis.claim_boundary: Primitive exact-reference method comparison only; no paper-L2 accuracy, scalable decoder, correction, LER, threshold, runtime scaling, or fault-tolerance claim.

acceptance_items.item: prospective question, literature basis, matrix, and stop rule
zero-safe content partition implementation and exact controls
acceptance_items.evidence: 56 exact-ceiling rows pass; maximum evidence-ratio error 1.998e-15 and marginal error 2.776e-16

acceptance_items.item: Lab, Wiki, metadata, and durable-state synthesis
acceptance_items.evidence: PLAN.md, REPORT.md, lab.json, labs/labs.json, Wiki roadmap/log, and .auto-research/state.json

outcome.decision: Stop optimizing mini-bucket packing. Next compare an explicit bounded region/join-graph family and a bounded tensor contraction as approximation-family alternatives on the same exact cohort.
